name: Ye Shiyuan the Thrall
summary: • When Sobek and The Thrall alternate turns, The Thrall gains 1 stack of Contract and 1 stack of Self-Sacrifice. Contract and Self-Sacrifice can stack up to 3 times. Each stack of Contract increases All-Attribute Anomaly RES by 15%, each stack of Self-Sacrifice reduces The Thrall's DEF by 8%. When The Thrall is Stunned, CRIT DMG taken increases by 50%.

appearances.description: • When Sobek and The Thrall alternate turns, The Thrall gains 1 stack of Contract and 1 stack of Self-Sacrifice. Contract and Self-Sacrifice can stack up to 3 times. Each stack of Contract increases All-Attribute Anomaly RES by 15%, each stack of Self-Sacrifice increases Stun DMG Multiplier by 10%. When The Thrall is Stunned, CRIT DMG taken increases by 50%.
appearances.performance: • When Agents inflict Weakened on Sobek and The Thrall, 1500 Performance Points will be awarded. When an Agent eliminates Sobek, 2000 Performance Points will be awarded. Up to a maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be earned.
appearances.misc: • Suitable for Agents with Stun specialty.
